seo_description: Miles Caton as Samuel “Sammie” Moore in Ryan Coogler's Sinners: the role, the guitar and the soundtrack.
label: The role
logline: Sammie is a preacher's son and blues guitarist in 1932 Mississippi, and his playing at his cousins' new juke joint draws in something dangerous. It was his first film role, opposite Michael B. Jordan.

dusk.line: The film takes place over one night at a juke joint in Clarksdale, Mississippi.
dusk.song_note: One of five soundtrack songs he sings on.

feature: He learned guitar for the role and plays a resonator guitar on screen. He also recorded much of the acoustic guitar on the soundtrack.
